# Wrap-up

At the end of the year, each owner says how their goals landed and what they learned.

Module id `wrap-up`, in [src/modules/wrap-up/](../../../src/modules/wrap-up/module.json).

## Requirements

- `RETRO`: From the last two weeks of a cycle, each owner wraps up their goals: how it landed (suggested from where it ended), one thing learned, carry on or stop. An admin then starts the next cycle; carried goals start from where they ended, stopped goals stay in the old cycle, and both are logged. (Copy.)
- `WRAP-UP-OPTIONAL`: An admin switches the Wrap-up off for a workspace. Off, nobody is asked how a goal landed (no wrap-up on Home, Goals, a goal or Cycles, no wrap-up page or tool); results are worked out as before and an admin still starts the next year from Cycles. Switching it off first says how many wrap-ups stay. Wrap-ups already written stay in History. (Copy.)
